page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 2.0 GB of RAM per CPU core.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The lack of local storage and the low memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:2 represent key architectural tradeoffs, making this server less suitable for memory-heavy databases or applications requiring high-speed local disk I/O.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c8ae.32xlarge offers high compute density, allowing organizations to run massive parallel processing tasks without paying for excess memory or unneeded local storage. Appropriate workloads for this hardware profile include compute-intensive applications, batch processing, video encoding, and highly parallelized simulation tasks that rely strictly on raw CPU capacity and high network throughput.
